A2_additional_relations.required_guard: Exactly one accepted/denied/exception return classification per actual ft_access invocation; query-admissible pre-ft_access rejection is frontend, not a commit attempt.
Joint snapshots are on successful admits/merges/accepted fills only. Do not treat them as cycle occupancy or add missed/retried fills twice.
Exactly one primary reason over observed non-skipped heads, including primary_none/unknown; masks are nonexclusive.

A2_equations.text: observed_heads = probe_skipped + sum(raw all7 statuses + raw_unknown)
ways_examined = sum(5 exclusive same-set way reasons)
pressure_prod_probe_reached = pressure_rewrite_miss + pressure_rewrite_hit_reserved + pressure_kept_fail + pressure_relief_not_consulted + pressure_intermediate_other
slice every field = sum(disjoint phase every field); global every field = sum(slice every field)
live_detached = detach_success-detached_retired; final valid epoch requires0; detached_responses are requester-count, not retired transaction-count
old detached counter = new detach_success at final snapshot

D16_to_A2_15_mapping.review: Sum raw_hit/raw_hit_reserved/raw_miss/raw_reservation_fail/raw_sector_miss/raw_mshr_hit/raw_write_allocated/raw_unknown plus probe_skipped. Need skipped subpartition and requester-class membership separately.
A2 has Tdisabled/Tenabled but no feature_scope_unknown field. Exact frontend feature state must be always known under raw probe, or missing scope makes equation/causal inference UNKNOWN.
A2 omits candidate_scan_unknown. Need exact full-scan coverage and geometry assertion; any not-run/partial scan must be NA/invalid rather than assigned noeligible0.
Five exclusive bins known; release must define live identity/generation validation, first-failure priority, predicate bit order and no modeled lookup/selection side effect.
No reach_unknown field. Need same raw-shadow instant and actual production hook reach proof, including early branches; otherwise tables separate and relation NA.

A2 combines evaluation and status into5 buckets. Derive evaluated=rewrite_miss+rewrite_hit_reserved+kept_fail+intermediate_other only when every bucket definition confirmed; notconsulted remains separate.
Explicit HIT_RESERVED exists. intermediate_other needs exact interpretation: other measured enum versus unknown/not-evaluated; do not turn unknown into measured enum.
pressure_rewrite_miss = rewritten_final_admitted + rewritten_final_denied + rewritten_final_unknown if all are same matched intermediate-MISS population. Final schema/source must bind this.
No relieve_exception counter in flat list. Need exact exception accounting policy/terminal invalidation so equality applies only normally returned calls, or explicit emitted exception metadata.
detach_calls success+false+exception. Need detach_false first-reason partition and selected_identity_mismatch fatal validity rule.

Sum8 post_relief status bins = actual normally reached post-relief probes, never automatically detach_calls or successful detach. Need exact normally-returned relation and no-probe exceptional branches.
EPL2ROV1 detached versus new detach_success, exact new binary source/slice/interval initial snapshot; no old-binary counters.

Successful detach with matched trigger invocation = accepted_after_detach+denied_after_detach+exception_after_detach (unknown only if explicitly not linked). denied_* appear all commit denials; cannot claim per-trigger first-gate distribution without source mapping/bounded sample evidence.

live_detached is referenced but not counter_fields. It may be record metadata. Need explicit initial_live_detached and final_live_detached or proved epoch initial0 with measured final scalar; retirement transaction unit distinct from responses/sectors.

Existing accepted_ro = new ro_admits+ro_merges on exact scope. Final release must say source frontend acceptance semantics unchanged and provide existing summary lines. Do not use requester_ro_candidate exposures as accepted request count.

A2 disjoint physical phase buckets are additive by construction; D old exact-requester kernel formula is not applicable because A2 declares no causal requester/victim mapping. Label SINGLE_ACTIVE_INTERVAL as interval only, OVERLAP_UNKNOWN/UNASSIGNED explicit residual; never sum old overlapping kernel intervals.

decision: Good interface-level coverage of main detach-zero funnel; suitable for preparing decoded-record adapter. Final metadata, source/fixture evidence and guard/phase membership definitions are still required before qualification. Absence from flat counter_fields does not imply absent runtime implementation.
